subject: Next steps & artifact mapping — SOC 2, audit logs, retention
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fintide.com>, Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fintide.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Mar 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & artifact mapping — SOC 2, audit logs, retention

Hi Hannah / Priya —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and a proposed artifact/timeline mapping so we can keep procurement and Infosec moving in parallel.

Key pain points you shared:
- Need clear evidence of audit logging and queryability for specific retention windows (90/365 days)
- SOC 2 attestation and narrative for Redwood-managed services
- Pen-test scope and whether results can be shared under NDA
- DPA language around log retention, deletion, and subprocessor list

Goals we agreed on:
1) Confirm what artifacts Redwood can provide by Mar 10 (SOC 2 summary, anonymized audit-log sample, DPA redline)
2) Provide an anonymized audit-log extract and schema for your security team to validate (sample delivered Mar 8)
3) Align on pen-test coverage and timeframe (we can share scope; results require mutual NDA and redaction)

What Redwood will deliver (proposed):
- redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf — high-level control mapping + AICPA bridge (attachment)
- audit_log_sample_anonymized.csv — sampled events with identifiers removed (attachment)
- dpa_template_v1.docx — our standard customer DPA for you to review (attachment)
- pen_test_scope_outline.pdf — what is covered and expected delivery cadence

Immediate asks for Fintide by EOD Mon (Mar 8):
- Confirm whether 90-day or 365-day retention is required per dataset (S3 audit vs. application events)
- Identify internal recipient for DPA redline (name + email)
- Any specific event types you need present in the audit sample (auth, config change, API access, admin actions)

Proposed next steps:
- Mar 8: Deliver anonymized audit-log sample + SOC2 summary (we will upload to the Drive link below)
- Mar 10: Redwood provides initial DPA redline and pen-test scope
- Mar 12: 30-min follow-up with your Infosec to walk through the sample and map any gaps

Shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FintideSOC2Folder

If this lines up, I’ll schedule the Mar 12 slot — thinking 10:00 AM PT — and lock in owners.

Thanks,

Sofia Ivanova
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF, 12 pages); audit_log_sample_anonymized.csv (CSV, sample, 500 rows); dpa_template_v1.docx (DOCX); pen_test_scope_outline.pdf (PDF)

From: Hannah Lee <hannah.lee@fintide.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@fintide.com>, Marco D'Angelo <m.dangelo@fintide.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps & artifact mapping — SOC 2, audit logs, retention

Sofia — thanks for the detailed summary. Quick clarifications from our side:

1) Retention: primary requirement is 365 days for admin/API access logs; 90 days for ephemeral request traces is acceptable. We can confirm the dataset mapping by Mon EOD.
2) Audit sample: please include at least auth (login/fail/success), token rotation, and admin config changes.
3) DPA: procurement will own the clause review — copying Priya. Priya, can you confirm who will redline?
4) Pen test: Marco (copied) will coordinate. We require the vendor pen-test scope and a statement of whether vulnerabilities are retained in vendor trackers. Results can be shared under NDA / redaction.

We’re good with the Mar 8/Mar 10 cadence. If possible, deliver the audit sample in CSV plus a short README that explains each field.

Thanks,

Hannah Lee
Head of Security Operations
Fintide Financial
hannah.lee@fintide.com
(617) 555-0123

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 6 Mar 2027 12:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & artifact mapping — SOC 2, audit logs, retention

Hi Hannah / Sofia —

Looping in details from engineering/controls so expectations are clear on what we can provide by the dates above.

Artifact delivery details:
- SOC2 summary (redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf): this will include our auditor opinion date, scope (hosting + platform services), and control mapping to CC and security categories. Not a full report, but sufficient for an initial assessment.
- Audit log sample (audit_log_sample_anonymized.csv): we will sample ~500 events across the last 30 days, remove PII, and include a README with schema and retention policy pointers. Sensitive fields will be hashed/anonymized.
- DPA redline (dpa_template_v1.docx): legal will provide an initial redline; we can accept a limited retention exception if required but prefer to align on subprocessor lists first.
- Pen test scope (pen_test_scope_outline.pdf): covers network, platform, and model inference surface; we do annual pen tests and can provide scope and remediation policy. Full findings require NDA and manual redaction.

Engineering notes / constraints:
- We can produce audit log extracts for the following event categories: auth, API calls, config changes, admin console actions, and model load events.
- Long-term retention (365d) is available but requires explicit acceptance in the DPA for certain dataset types.

Timeline commitment (to be uploaded to the Drive):
- Mar 8: Audit sample + README + SOC2 summary
- Mar 10: DPA redline + pen-test scope
- Mar 12: Follow-up call (30 min) to validate sample and walk through any missing event types

Ben will coordinate the upload and notify when files are live. If you need additional formats (Parquet, Splunk export), say so and we’ll scope it.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Security
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Thanks — that timeline works. Procurement will own the DPA redline; I’m the point person and will send an initial redline by Mar 11. For your planning: we expect PO + signature on the MSA to follow the DPA agreement (tentative target Mar 24).

One ask from procurement: please include a short statement in the DPA redline that confirms Redwood’s data deletion workflow and the ability to export logs in a customer-readable format (CSV/Parquet).

We’ll be on the Mar 12 call (Hannah + Marco will attend for Infosec). Please send the calendar invite.
